RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.title: Mine Depth
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.description:
Current Depth: {Amount}.
[green]Buffs[/green]
10+: Attacks deal 2 extra damage.
20+: Gain a potion the first time you enter Depth 20-29.
30-60: At combat end, gain 10 gold per turn taken.
61+: At combat end, 50% chance to gain a relic.
[red]Debuffs[/red]
20+: At end of turn, take 6 damage while you have no Sand Beast (blockable).
51+: At end of turn, take 7 more damage (blockable; stacks with the above: 13 total).
51+: You can no longer summon Sand Beasts.
Depth 100+ for 3 turns in a row: you die.

(Debuffs are threshold-based and persist. The gold/relic buffs are exclusive depth bands.)
RAY_MOD_POWER_AMMO_POWER.title: Ammo
RAY_MOD_POWER_AMMO_POWER.description:
Current Ammo: {Amount} / {Cap}.
Ammo is capped at {Cap} and normally cannot exceed it (except on a turn where [gold]Infinite[/gold] is active).
Some attacks spend Ammo to boost damage;
if you are short, the card still works using the Ammo you actually have.
Each combat you start with the initial load and the cap returns to its base value.
RAY_MOD_POWER_PENDING_DEPTH_LOSS_POWER.d: At the start of your next {Amount} turns, lose 6 [gold]Depth[/gold].
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_MARK_POWER.desc:
Each stack makes this enemy take 10% more attack damage.
Currently {Amount} stacks (marks from several Sand Beasts stack).
Only the first few attack cards each turn can benefit, equal to your Sand Beast cap; each card counts once.
When the Sand Beast that placed this mark leaves, remove one stack.
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_QUOTA_POWER.des:
This turn, {Amount} more attack cards can benefit from Sand Beast Marks.
Your Sand Beast cap resets to 2 each combat (max 6); the cap is also how many cards can benefit per turn.
Only attacks that hit a marked enemy count, and a card that misses out does not spend the quota.
RAY_MOD_POWER_REFINED_BULLET_POWER.title: Refined Bullet
RAY_MOD_POWER_REFINED_BULLET_POWER.descr: Your next {Amount} Attack(s) deal additional damage equal to your current [blue]Ammo[/blue], then lose 1 [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_POWER_FORWARD_POWER.title: Forward
RAY_MOD_POWER_FORWARD_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Depth[/gold].
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_LAIR_POWER.desc: At the start of each turn, add {Amount} [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] to your hand.
RAY_MOD_POWER_INFINITE_AMMO_POWER.title: Infinite Ammo
RAY_MOD_POWER_INFINITE_AMMO_POWER.descri: At the start of each turn, gain {Amount} [blue]Ammo[/blue] capacity.
RAY_MOD_POWER_DARKNESS_POWER.title: Darkness Below
RAY_MOD_POWER_DARKNESS_POWER.description: Lose [gold]Strength[/gold] until the end of this turn.
RAY_MOD_POWER_MAGAZINE_POWER.title: Magazine
RAY_MOD_POWER_MAGAZINE_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, if your [blue]Ammo[/blue] is below its cap, gain {Amount} [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_HER_POWER.title: The Sand Beast and Her
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_HER_POWER.descr: [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] Marks are 20% stronger (10% to 12% per stack).
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_FURY_POWER.desc: This turn, whenever you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold]. You lose it at the end of this turn.
RAY_MOD_POWER_SAND_BEAST_BLESS_POWER.des: Whenever you summon 4 [gold]Sand Beasts[/gold], gain {Amount} Energy.
RAY_MOD_POWER_FUNDS_POWER.title: Funds
RAY_MOD_POWER_FUNDS_POWER.description: Whenever your [gold]Depth[/gold] changes by a total of 12, draw {Amount} card(s).
RAY_MOD_POWER_SOURCE_ORE_POWER.title: Source Ore
RAY_MOD_POWER_SOURCE_ORE_POWER.descripti: Whenever your [gold]Depth[/gold] changes, deal {Amount} damage to a random enemy.
RAY_MOD_POWER_GO_ALL_OUT_POWER.title: Go All Out
RAY_MOD_POWER_GO_ALL_OUT_POWER.descripti: This turn, Block you gain from other cards is reduced by {Amount}%.
RAY_MOD_POWER_SEARCHLIGHT_POWER.title: Searchlight
RAY_MOD_POWER_SEARCHLIGHT_POWER.descript: You are unaffected by [gold]Depth[/gold] penalties next turn ({Amount} turn(s) remaining).
RAY_MOD_POWER_EXPLORATORY_WELL_DRILLER_P: The first card you play each turn that has a [gold]Depth[/gold] requirement ignores it.
RAY_MOD_POWER_AMMO_LEDGER_POWER.title: Ammo Damage Ledger
RAY_MOD_POWER_AMMO_LEDGER_POWER.descript: Tracks the total damage your [blue]Ammo[/blue]-related Attack cards have dealt this turn.
RAY_MOD_POWER_LOADING_POSTURE_POWER.desc: Whenever you play a card, gain {Amount} [blue]Ammo[/blue] and +{Amount} max [blue]Ammo[/blue].
RAY_MOD_POWER_HARD_AS_ROCKS_POWER.title: Hard as Rocks
RAY_MOD_POWER_HARD_AS_ROCKS_POWER.descri: Whenever a creature's [green]Buff[/green] changes, gain {Amount} Block.
RAY_MOD_POWER_ANIMAL_GUIDE_POWER.title: Animal Guide
RAY_MOD_POWER_ANIMAL_GUIDE_POWER.descrip: At the start of each turn, add {Amount} [gold]Sand Beast[/gold]-related card(s) to your hand.
RAY_MOD_POWER_FERANMUTS_POWER.title: Feranmuts
RAY_MOD_POWER_FERANMUTS_POWER.descriptio: Draw 1 additional card and gain +1 [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] cap each turn, and you may choose 2 cards in your hand to [gold]Transform[/gold] into [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] (cap gained so far: +{Amount}).
RAY_MOD_POWER_ACCUMULATE_POWER.title: Accumulate
RAY_MOD_POWER_ACCUMULATE_POWER.descripti: At the start of your next combat, set your [gold]Depth[/gold] to the value it had when this combat ended.
RAY_MOD_POWER_PET_BLOGGER_POWER.title: Pet Blogger
RAY_MOD_POWER_PET_BLOGGER_POWER.descript: When you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], instead apply 1 [gold]Sand Beast[/gold] mark to every enemy and deal {Amount} damage to every marked enemy.
RAY_MOD_POWER_STRANGE_TREASURE_POWER.des: Whenever you play a card that costs 0, set a random card in your draw pile to cost 0 until played, and double the cost of a random card in your hand until played.
RAY_MOD_POWER_BULLET_MODE_POWER.title: Bullet Mode
RAY_MOD_POWER_BULLET_MODE_POWER.descript:
Your cards cost [blue]Ammo[/blue] instead of Energy, and you cannot play a card you cannot afford with [blue]Ammo[/blue].
For X-cost cards, X becomes your current [blue]Ammo[/blue] (all of it is spent).
RAY_MOD_POWER_ENGROSSED_POWER.title: Engrossed
RAY_MOD_POWER_ENGROSSED_POWER.descriptio: Attacks that spend [blue]Ammo[/blue] deal 1.5 times damage; each consecutive attack on the same enemy gains +10% (currently {Amount} stacks; resets when you switch targets).
RAY_MOD_POWER_PROVE_WHAT_POWER.title: Prove What?
RAY_MOD_POWER_PROVE_WHAT_POWER.descripti: At the start of your next turn, you die.
RAY_MOD_POWER_NURTURE_POWER.title: Nurture
RAY_MOD_POWER_NURTURE_POWER.description: Whenever you summon a [gold]Sand Beast[/gold], add an equal number of "Sand Beast" cards to your hand (summons caused by playing the "Sand Beast" card don't count).
RAY_MOD_POWER_HOLOGRAPHIC_MODELING_POWER: At the end of combat, choose one of your relics to copy; the copy disappears after {Amount} combat(s).
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_gold: Depth 30-60: At combat end, gain 10 gold per turn taken.
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_relic: Depth 61+: At combat end, 50% chance to gain a relic.
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_noBeast: Depth 20+: At end of turn, take 6 damage while you have no Sand Beast (blockable).
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_extraDama: Depth 51+: At end of turn, take 7 more damage (blockable; stacks with the above: 13 total).
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_noSummon: Depth 51+: You can no longer summon Sand Beasts.
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_death: Depth 100+ for 3 turns in a row: you die.
RAY_MOD_POWER_DEPTH_POWER.line_none: No buffs or debuffs are active.
